title: Count with a condition
description:
Write `int countLongWords(const std::vector<std::string>& words, std::size_t minLength)` that returns how many words have at least `minLength` letters.

Use `std::count_if` with a lambda. The lambda needs `minLength`, which lives outside it, so it must **capture** it: `[minLength](const std::string& word) { ... }`.
